name: 猎聘求职助手
description: Connect WorkBuddy to your Liepin account for job search, resume review and confirmed applications.
description_zh: 通过猎聘官方本地 CLI 搜索职位、查看简历，并在你明确确认后更新求职期望或投递。
description_en: Search Liepin jobs, review your resume, and update expectations or apply only after your explicit confirmation.
examples_zh: 在猎聘查深圳的产品经理岗位，薪资 25k 到 35k
读取我的猎聘简历，帮我总结优势和缺项
先搜索并比较匹配岗位，投递前让我确认
examples_en: Search Liepin for product manager jobs in Shenzhen, paying 25k to 35k
Read my Liepin resume and summarize strengths and gaps
Compare matching jobs and ask before applying
